text:
Predicates:
Flies(x, y, z) ::: x flies from y to z.
Premises:
Flies(susan, ?, lga) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
∀x ∀y ∀z (Flies(x, y, z) → y ≠ z) ::: The departure and arrival can not be the same airport.
Flies(john, lga, ?) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
Flies(john, ?, lga) ::: John flies to LGA airport.
